ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels represent less than 5% of the total visible ventral surface, restricted to small focal spots and water-induced glare.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly uniform dark-grey to black pigmentation across approximately 95% of the visible surface; no contiguous white geometric blobs or distinct banding patterns are present; faint low-contrast mottling is visible in the central region near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees; the depth of the notch is roughly 12-15% of the vertical fluke height visible above the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; peaks and valleys are sharp and continuous across the entirety of the visible trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading outer edges follow a convex trajectory; the trailing edges exhibit a global concave sweep toward the median notch, heavily modulated by the serration map.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast light-colored clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the lower-left lobe and the central-right quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular, high-contrast textured masses corresponding to dense barnacle colonization are attached to the distal terminal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
